About Us

Who we are

About Morgan TechFest

Morgan TechFest is an annual technology innovation platform hosted by Morgan State University, bringing together students, faculty, and the broader academic community to solve real-world technology problems, showcase cutting-edge research, and foster meaningful innovation and collaboration.

How it started

The Founding

Morgan TechFest began in 2022, when Opeyemi Adeniran set out to build a technology conference at Morgan State that would connect students directly with the companies shaping the industry. Working through university channels and sustained cold outreach, the inaugural event brought Google, Microsoft, ROKU, Bloomberg, Goldman Sachs, JOS, HBCU20x20, Fannie Mae, and M&T Bank to campus, with Bloomberg as founding sponsor.

The first conference was built by a small team over a single year, covering program, venue, registration, publicity, and partnerships. It has run every year since.

Supporting student organizations
Women in Computer Science (WiCS), Society for Advancement of Computer Science (SACS), OneTrybe, and the Graduate Student Association (GSA) carried the event across their networks in 2022.
